defects.evidence: This is the weakest Crestline bullet because it describes ownership of a report and meeting without showing what changed as a result.
This is too passive and does not show enough of your contribution.
Moving from 75% to 95% is a 20-percentage-point increase and approximately a 26.7% relative increase.
The arithmetic is incorrect: going from 400 to 1,150 is a 187.5% increase, not a 150% increase.
This contains too many separate accomplishments: software rollout, SOP redesign, driver training, vendor negotiations, and labor savings. Split it into separate bullets.
In standard RICE, Reach generally refers to the number of users or customers affected in a defined period, not simply the number of support tickets a feature might close.
The current Diesel Mechanic role conflicts with the product/operations direction suggested by your MBA, product internship, and projects.

Your entries are not in reverse chronological order: Coastal Marine Services July 2025–Present; Harbor Payments June–August 2024; Crestline Logistics July 2018–August 2023. Harbor Payments should appear before Crestline.
